HOME SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management.

2. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects.

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cake Making and Decoration? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cake Making and Decoration.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cake Making and Decoration.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cake Making and Decoration.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cake Making and Decoration.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Appearance and Etiquette.

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meal Service? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meal Service.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meal Service.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Meal Service.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meal Service.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Time and Energy Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Control of Household Pests and Insects and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Laundering of Fabrics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
